Soft Ginger Cookies

Chewy, warmly spiced and ready in under half an hour.

Ingredients

  • 6 tablespoons of unsalted butter
  • 2/3 cup coconut sugar (or any brown sugar you have)
  • 1/4 cup packed dark brown sugar
  • 2 teaspoons vanilla
  • 1 egg
  • 1 1/4 cups all purpose flour (5.6 ounces)
  • 1 teaspoon ground ginger
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt (a pinch more if you like)
  • 1/2 cup chocolate chips (or chopped crystallised ginger)

Instructions

  1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Melt the butter until just liquid.
  2. Beat the butter with both sugars until glossy, then beat in the vanilla and egg.
  3. Stir in the flour, ginger and salt, then the chocolate chips.
  4. Roll into balls, set them well apart on a lined sheet and bake for 9 minutes.
  5. Leave on the sheet for 5 minutes so the centres set.
